item.title: EplayerX 1.2.57
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 新增 iPhone 遥控播放。在同一局域网配对后，可以把视频从 iPhone 接续到 Mac，并遥控播放进度、音量、字幕和弹幕。也可以把字幕字体发送到 Mac，在字幕设置中管理。 - 改进弹幕人物遮挡，让弹幕尽量避开画面中的人物。 - 改进 SubHD 字幕下载与验证。遇到验证时，可在播放器中完成，也可交给已配对的 iPhone 处理。 - 修复云盘首页混入 Trakt「今日更新」的问题，并改善部分图像字幕边缘的显示效果。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。遥控功能需要支持「连接设备」的 iPhone 版 EplayerX。
## What’s New
- Use your iPhone as a playback remote. Pair on the same local network to continue a video on your Mac and control playback, volume, subtitles, and on-screen comments. You can also send subtitle fonts to your Mac and manage them in subtitle settings. - Improved person detection so on-screen comments are less likely to cover people in the video. - Improved SubHD subtitle downloads and verification. If verification is required, complete it in the player or send it to your paired iPhone. - Fixed Trakt’s Today Updates appearing on cloud library home pages and improved edge rendering for some bitmap subtitles.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Remote playback requires a version of EplayerX for iPhone with Connect Devices support.
